questions.q: What does the Execute Pipeline activity do?
options: Lets a pipeline invoke a completely different pipeline as one of its own activities
Copies data from a source to a sink
Deletes a pipeline permanently
Only works inside a Switch activity
questions.explain: Execute Pipeline calls another pipeline, passing it parameter values, exactly like calling a function from within another function.

questions.q: How does Execute Pipeline work around ForEach's no-nesting limitation?
options: A ForEach can contain an Execute Pipeline activity, whose target pipeline has its own inner ForEach
It removes the nesting limitation entirely, allowing direct ForEach-in-ForEach nesting
It converts the outer ForEach into an Until activity automatically
Execute Pipeline has nothing to do with ForEach nesting
questions.explain: Since a ForEach can't directly contain another ForEach, calling a separate pipeline (with its own ForEach) via Execute Pipeline achieves the same nested-loop effect indirectly.

questions.q: What does setting waitOnCompletion to false change?
options: The outer pipeline fires the inner pipeline and moves on immediately, without waiting for it to finish
The inner pipeline is deleted after running once
Parameters can no longer be passed to the inner pipeline
The outer pipeline pauses indefinitely until manually resumed
questions.explain: waitOnCompletion: true (the default) waits for the inner pipeline and surfaces its status. false fires it and continues immediately — useful for independent work, but the outer pipeline won't know if the inner one succeeded.

questions.q: Why does Execute Pipeline use parameters rather than variables to pass values into the invoked pipeline?
options: Parameters give each call its own independent values, with no shared state to race against — unlike pipeline-scoped variables
Variables can't be referenced inside any activity at all
Parameters and variables are interchangeable here — either works identically
Execute Pipeline doesn't support passing any values at all
questions.explain: Variables are scoped to a single pipeline and aren't thread-safe across parallel work (Lesson 17). Parameters are the clean mechanism for passing values between pipelines.

questions.q: What's an example of a real reuse benefit from Execute Pipeline?
options: A single "copy one table" pipeline can be called by three different parent pipelines with three different table-name parameters
It automatically publishes every pipeline to production
It eliminates the need for any linked services
It merges all pipelines in a data factory into a single pipeline
questions.explain: Reusing one well-parameterized inner pipeline from multiple callers beats maintaining several near-identical copies of the same logic.
